title: Room Heater Skin Care: How to Stop Dry, Itchy Skin in Winter
ex: Why heaters dry out skin, how to set up the room, a daily and night routine for heater season, and warning signs that need a doctor.
rt: Room Heater Skin Care: Stop Winter Dryness | Mirc Glow
rd: Room heater skin care for Indian winters: keep moisture in the room, sit at a safe distance and moisturise damp skin. Daily and night routine for dry skin.
quick: Room heaters make indoor winter air drier, which pulls water from your skin. Keep a bowl of water or humidifier in the room, point the heater away from your face and bed, use lukewarm water, and apply cream on slightly damp skin after every wash and at bedtime.
facts: Heated winter air dries skin faster
Keep the heater pointed away from face and bed
Apply cream within 2–3 minutes of washing
Never sleep with a coal angithi in a closed room
